 2                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   The 

 3   Senate will come to order.

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   With us 

10   today to give the invocation is Bishop Julius 

11   Abiola, of Christ Life Ministries in Brooklyn.

12                Bishop Abiola.

13                BISHOP ABIOLA:   Thank you, 

14   Senator.  

15                Almighty God, unto Whom all hearts 

16   are open, all desires known, from Whom no 

17   secrets are hid and from Whom all blessings 

18   flow, we come before You today and we thank You 

19   for the blessings that You have given unto us, 

20   especially that You have given unto these 

21   honorable men and women of our Senate of the 

22   greatest state in the union.  

23                Cleanse our thoughts, O God, and 

24   every thought of our hearts by the inspiration 

25   of the Holy Spirit, that we may perfectly love 


                                                                598

 1   You and worthily magnify Your holy name.  

 2                Bless our differences and us, and 

 3   under God our courage to stand together in the 

 4   fear and reverence of You as we fulfill our 

 5   civic responsibilities.  

 6                Our Father, maker of heaven and 

 7   earth, possessor of the whole universe, as we 

 8   gather in Your glorious presence we pray that 

 9   You make us worthy to stand before You with a 

10   clear conscience that is void of offense, 

11   through the sacrifice of Your son Jesus Christ, 

12   in whose name we pray.  

13                Amen.

14                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Thank 

15   you, Bishop Abiola.
